{{- /* layouts/_partials/scripts-body-end/extra.html Auto-injects search modal HTML + FlexSearch CDN + search.js when search.enable = true. Auto-injects clipboard.js when clipboard = true. Sub-theme can override to add more scripts AFTER Base auto-injections. */ -}} {{- /* ── Search capability ── */ -}} {{- with .Site.Params.search -}} {{- if .enable -}} {{- $variant := .variant | default "modal" -}} {{- if eq $variant "inline" -}} {{- else -}} {{- partial "search.html" $ -}} {{- end -}} {{- end -}} {{- end -}} {{- /* ── Clipboard capability ── */ -}} {{- if .Site.Params.clipboard -}} {{- end -}} {{- /* ── TOC interactive ── */ -}} {{- $tocVariant := "static" -}} {{- with .Site.Params.toc -}} {{- $tocVariant = .variant | default "static" -}} {{- end -}} {{- if eq $tocVariant "interactive" -}} {{- end -}} {{- /* ── Explorer capability ── */ -}} {{- if .Site.Params.explorer -}} {{- end -}} {{- /* ── Graph capability ── */ -}} {{- if .Site.Params.graph -}} {{- end -}}
